newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Imperial Credit outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Imperial Credit outperform.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it initiated coverage of Imperial Credit Mortgage Holdings Inc with an outperformer rating for the intermediate and long term.
-- It said in a report the company's tax-free REIT structure provides a competitive advantage versus other non-REIT portfolio lenders.
-- EVEREN estimates EPS of $1.80 in 1996 and $2.25 in 1997.
